_comment: Aircraft with a modelled canopy (canopy.py). Lengths in blocks (1 block = 1 m at these models' scale); dz relative to the pilot's eye (+ forward). glass_mm: transparency thickness. bows: frames across the glass ({dz, width, yoke}). front / rear: the canopy's ends (z) when the old glass's are wrong. profile: reference overrides {crown|sill|width: [[dz, value], ...]}. fullness: superellipse exponent of the sections (default: fitted). Sources per aircraft in tools/canopy_models/README.md.
_pending: Aircraft the generic fit does not yet get right (wavy sills, windscreens the old glass never covered, frames left standing); --fleet leaves them with their old canopy until each has its own entry.
